camel_example: aliyun polardb CreateDatabaseZonal --region cn-hangzhou --CharacterSetName utf8 --DBClusterId 'pc-**************' --DBName testDB
description_en: Creates an ApsaraDB PolarDB on ENS database
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-database-zonal --db-cluster-id 'pc-**************' --db-name testDB --character-set-name utf8 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabaseZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB on ENS edge cluster. Standard PolarDB cluster IDs are not supported
parameters.help_zh: PolarDB ENS 边缘集群 ID；普通 PolarDB 集群 ID 不适用
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. The name must meet the following requirements:

It can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
It must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit. It can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、中划线（-）、下划线（_）组成。
以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾，最长 64 个字符
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the database. The description must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库备注信息，备注信息需满足如下要求：

不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
长度为 2~256 个字符
parameters.name: db_description

parameters.help_en: The name of the account that is authorized to access the database
parameters.help_zh: 授权访问该数据库的账号名
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The permissions of the account. Valid values:

ReadWrite: read and write permissions
ReadOnly: read-only permissions
DMLOnly: DML-only permissions
DDLOnly: DDL-only permissions
ReadIndex: read and index permissions

Default value: ReadWrite
parameters.help_zh:
账号权限，取值范围如下：

ReadWrite：读写。
ReadOnly：只读。
DMLOnly：只允许 DML。
DDLOnly：只允许 DDL。
ReadIndex：只读+索引。

若该参数不填，则默认为 ReadWrite
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en: The locale setting used to specify the collation of the new database
parameters.help_zh: 语言环境设置，用于指定新建数据库的排序规则
parameters.name: collate

parameters.help_en: The locale setting used to specify the character classification of the database
parameters.help_zh: 语言环境设置，用于指定数据库的字符分类
parameters.name: ctype

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and is case-sensitive. It can contain up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
